41.10.solution:
WITH RECURSIVE b AS (SELECT sous_station, AVG(kwh) AS m, STDDEV_POP(kwh) AS sd FROM releves_electriques WHERE horodatage < '2028-03-01' GROUP BY sous_station), r AS (SELECT sous_station, AVG(kwh) AS m FROM releves_electriques WHERE horodatage >= '2028-03-01' GROUP BY sous_station), z AS (SELECT b.sous_station, b.m AS avant, r.m AS apres, (r.m - b.m) / b.sd AS z FROM b JOIN r ON r.sous_station = b.sous_station),
anomalie AS (SELECT ss.nom, ss.station, ss.payeur_siren FROM sous_stations ss JOIN z ON z.sous_station = ss.nom ORDER BY z.z DESC LIMIT 1),
p(noeud, chemin, total) AS (SELECT CAST('Préfecture' AS CHAR(64)), CAST('Préfecture' AS CHAR(1000)), 0 UNION ALL SELECT t.vers, CONCAT(p.chemin, ' > ', t.vers), p.total + t.minutes FROM p JOIN troncons t ON t.de = p.noeud WHERE t.etat = 'ouvert' AND LOCATE(t.vers, p.chemin) = 0 AND p.total + t.minutes <= 60 AND p.noeud <> (SELECT station FROM anomalie)),
trajet AS (SELECT MIN(total) AS minutes FROM p WHERE noeud = (SELECT station FROM anomalie)),
c AS (SELECT horodatage, CAST(JSON_VALUE(metriques, '$.acc') AS DOUBLE) AS y FROM minotaure_checkpoints ORDER BY epoch DESC LIMIT 48), x0 AS (SELECT MIN(horodatage) AS h FROM c), pts AS (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, x0.h, c.horodatage) / 3600 AS x, c.y FROM c CROSS JOIN x0), s AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(y) AS sy, SUM(x * x) AS sxx, SUM(x * y) AS sxy FROM pts), reg AS (SELECT (n * sxy - sx * sy) / (n * sxx - sx * sx) AS a, (sy - (n * sxy - sx * sy) / (n * sxx - sx * sx) * sx) / n AS b FROM s),
limite AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT((SELECT h FROM x0) + INTERVAL FLOOR((0.99 - b) / a * 3600) SECOND, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS h FROM reg),
ch(siren, part) AS (SELECT payeur_siren, CAST(100 AS DOUBLE) FROM anomalie UNION ALL SELECT pa.detenteur, ch.part * pa.pct / 100 FROM participations pa JOIN ch ON pa.detenue = ch.siren),
benef AS (SELECT REPLACE(siren, 'PERSONNE:', '') AS nom FROM ch WHERE siren LIKE 'PERSONNE:%' GROUP BY siren HAVING SUM(part) > 25),
f AS (SELECT DISTINCT numero FROM bornages WHERE antenne = 'Fleury-Mérogis'),
lien AS (SELECT appelant AS x, appele AS y FROM communications UNION SELECT appele, appelant FROM communications),
cible AS (SELECT DISTINCT bo.numero FROM bornages bo JOIN antennes an ON an.antenne = bo.antenne WHERE an.station = (SELECT station FROM anomalie)),
tel AS (SELECT DISTINCT ab.titulaire FROM f JOIN lien l1 ON l1.x = f.numero JOIN lien l2 ON l2.x = l1.y JOIN cible ON cible.numero = l2.y JOIN abonnes ab ON ab.numero = l2.y),
iv AS (SELECT host, domaine, ip_dest, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAG(horodatage) OVER (PARTITION BY host, domaine ORDER BY horodatage), horodatage) AS dt FROM proxy_logs WHERE domaine NOT IN (SELECT domaine FROM domaines_connus)),
st AS (SELECT host, domaine, ip_dest, COUNT(dt) AS n, AVG(dt) AS m, STDDEV_POP(dt) AS sd FROM iv WHERE dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY host, domaine, ip_dest HAVING COUNT(dt) >= 50),
c2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT ip_dest FROM st WHERE sd / m < 0.05),
serveur AS (SELECT l.ip FROM c2 JOIN lignes_internet l ON l.ip = c2.ip_dest WHERE l.station = (SELECT station FROM anomalie))
SELECT (SELECT station FROM anomalie) AS station, (SELECT minutes FROM trajet) AS minutes, (SELECT h FROM limite) AS heure_limite, (SELECT ip FROM serveur) AS serveur, nom AS complice FROM benef WHERE nom IN (SELECT titulaire FROM tel);

require.msg: Le chemin et la propriété exigent une CTE récursive.
Ne recopie aucune valeur trouvée avant (station, sous-station, personne, antenne, société, numéro) : la requête doit tout retrouver seule.

hints: Assemble dans une seule WITH RECURSIVE les pièces des missions précédentes : z-score (STDDEV_POP), plus court chemin (CTE récursive avec CAST en CHAR et CONCAT), régression (JSON_VALUE, TIMESTAMPDIFF, DATE_FORMAT), chaîne de propriété (parts en DOUBLE), téléphonie et balises (LAG).

La sous-station anormale (ORDER BY z DESC LIMIT 1) fournit la station, qui remplace toutes les valeurs tapées à la main ; le SELECT final lit chaque CTE par une sous-requête scalaire et garde le bénéficiaire présent dans la piste téléphonique.
41.10.note: Mêmes adaptations que dans les missions précédentes : STDDEV_POP, JSON_VALUE, TIMESTAMPDIFF et DATE_FORMAT (%i pour les minutes), CONCAT et LOCATE, CAST des ancrages récursifs.

41.A.solution: WITH h AS (SELECT horodatage, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, '2028-02-15', horodatage) AS n FROM releves_electriques WHERE sous_station = 'SST Dédale' AND kwh > 20), g AS (SELECT horodatage, n - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n) AS SIGNED) AS grp FROM h), i AS (SELECT MIN(horodatage) AS debut, MAX(horodatage) AS fin FROM g GROUP BY grp), t AS (SELECT LAG(fin) OVER (ORDER BY debut) AS arret, debut AS reprise FROM i) SELECT arret, reprise, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, arret, reprise) / 3600) AS heures FROM t WHERE arret IS NOT NULL ORDER BY arret;
hints: Reprends les îlots de 41.3 (TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ...) et n - ROW_NUMBER()), puis LAG(fin) OVER (ORDER BY debut) donne la fin de l'îlot précédent.
L'écart en heures : ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, arret, reprise) / 3600) AS heures, en gardant arret IS NOT NULL.

WITH RECURSIVE nm AS (SELECT siren AS id, nom AS label FROM societes UNION SELECT detenteur, REPLACE(detenteur, 'PERSONNE:', '') FROM participations WHERE detenteur LIKE 'PERSONNE:%'),
e(a, b) AS (SELECT detenteur, detenue FROM participations UNION SELECT detenue, detenteur FROM participations),
dep AS (SELECT CONCAT('PERSONNE:', prenom, ' ', nom) AS id FROM employes WHERE poste = 'Directeur SI'),
arr AS (SELECT CONCAT('PERSONNE:', nom) AS id FROM employes_neurocite WHERE poste = 'Directeur data science'),
p(noeud, vus, chemin, sauts) AS (
  SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR(100)), CAST(CONCAT('|', id, '|') AS CHAR(2000)), CAST(REPLACE(id, 'PERSONNE:', '') AS CHAR(2000)), 0 FROM dep
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.b, CONCAT(p.vus, e.b, '|'), CONCAT(p.chemin, ' > ', (SELECT label FROM nm WHERE nm.id = e.b)), p.sauts + 1
  FROM p JOIN e ON e.a = p.noeud WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT('|', e.b, '|'), p.vus) = 0 AND p.sauts < 12)
SELECT chemin, sauts FROM p WHERE noeud = (SELECT id FROM arr) ORDER BY sauts LIMIT 1;
hints: Construis les identifiants de départ et d'arrivée avec CONCAT('PERSONNE:', prenom, ' ', nom) ; || est un OU logique en MariaDB.

Dans la CTE récursive, caste l'ancrage (noeud en CHAR(100), vus et chemin en CHAR(2000)) ; la liste vus entourée de | et LOCATE(CONCAT('|', e.b, '|'), p.vus) = 0 empêchent de repasser par un nœud. Termine par ORDER BY sauts LIMIT 1.
41.S.note: CONCAT et LOCATE remplacent || et instr ; les colonnes de l'ancrage sont castées pour accueillir les chemins plus longs.
